usage: for portions, copies and shares: a newspaper (一份报纸), a gift (一份礼物), a job (一份工作).
exampleEn: He found a new job.

usage: for paintings, maps and scrolls (一幅画, 一幅地图).
exampleEn: A painting is hanging on the wall.

usage: for large fixed structures and mountains: bridges, buildings, cities (一座桥, 一座山).
exampleEn: There is a bridge over the river.

usage: for plants and trees (一棵树, 一棵草, 一棵白菜).
exampleEn: There is a big tree in front of my house.

usage: for thin flat pieces (一片面包, 一片树叶) and wide open expanses (一片草地, 一片大海).
exampleEn: I ate a slice of bread.

usage: for pieces of writing: articles, essays and diary entries (一篇文章, 一篇日记).
exampleEn: He writes a diary entry every day.

usage: for trains and orderly lines (一列火车, 一列队伍).
exampleEn: A train passed over the bridge.

usage: for machines and equipment: computers, televisions and other devices (一台电脑).
exampleEn: I bought a new computer.

usage: for dishes (一道菜), questions (一道题), doors (一道门) and beams of light (一道光).
exampleEn: Mom made five dishes.

usage: for films and TV series (一部电影), novels (一部小说) and phones (一部手机).
example: 我昨天看了一部很好看的电影。
exampleEn: I watched a wonderful movie yesterday.

usage: for abstract countable items: tasks, projects, research and sports events.
example: 这是今天最重要的一项任务。
exampleEn: This is the most important task today.

usage: for issues of magazines or programs (这期杂志, 第三期) and phases of a project (一期工程).
example: 这期杂志有我最喜欢的文章。
exampleEn: This issue of the magazine has my favorite article.

usage: for songs and poems (一首歌, 一首诗).
exampleEn: I can sing a Chinese song.

usage: a whole outfit of clothes (一身新衣服) and a body covered or filled with (一身汗, 一身泥).
example: 过年的时候，他穿了一身新衣服。
exampleEn: At Chinese New Year he wore a brand-new outfit.

usage: for two things that naturally go together: a pair or a couple (一对耳环, 一对夫妻).
example: 他们是一对幸福的夫妻。
exampleEn: They are a happy married couple.

usage: a row of (一排座位, 一排树); 第一排 = the first row.
exampleEn: I am sitting in the first row.

usage: times, -fold: 两倍 = twice, 三倍 = three times (used in comparisons).
example: 这个房间比那个大一倍。
exampleEn: This room is twice as big as that one.

usage: gram (一百克, 两克盐).
exampleEn: He bought 200 grams of beef.

usage: kilometer (三公里).
exampleEn: School is two kilometers from my home.

usage: liang, a traditional weight of 50 grams (一斤 = 十两); still used for food and drink.
exampleEn: He bought two liang of tea leaves.

usage: degree Celsius (三十六摄氏度).
example: 今天气温三十八摄氏度。
exampleEn: It is 38 degrees Celsius today.

usage: night, as a span of time (一夜, 两夜).
exampleEn: He worked through the night without sleeping.

usage: second (十秒 = ten seconds).
exampleEn: The match has only ten seconds left.

usage: for events, shows and matches (一场电影, 一场比赛, 一场演出).
exampleEn: We went to see a movie.

usage: a trip, after verbs like 去, 跑 or 回 (去一趟 = make a trip).
exampleEn: I made a trip to the supermarket.

usage: for meals (一顿饭, 一天三顿) and, informally, for beatings (打了一顿).
exampleEn: We eat three meals a day.

usage: a box of (一盒糖, 一盒巧克力).
exampleEn: She gave me a box of chocolates.

usage: a bag or sack of (一袋米, 一袋面粉).
exampleEn: I bought a bag of rice.

usage: a bucket or barrel of (一桶水, 一桶油).
exampleEn: He carried a bucket of water over.

usage: a belly full of something, especially words or feelings (一肚子话, 一肚子气).
example: 她有一肚子话想跟妈妈说。
exampleEn: She has so much she wants to tell her mom.
